solution:
names = ["上次错题", "薄弱知识点", "学习进度", "偏好设置"]
values = [12, 5, 8, 3]
threshold = 5

picked = []
for i in range(len(names)):
    if values[i] >= threshold:
        picked.append(names[i])

print(picked)
